description: Canonical staging policy for P2 wave 1: oracle truth in jac-py/Modules/*.jac vs corpus/T8 truth in jac-py/Modules/_lifted/p2_corpus_wave1/*.jac

modules.note: Fresh-lift unsafe: naive c2jac still emits Tier-B (W4201 char casts) and lacks hand fixes (_uchar, byte-buffer strcpy/cat). Hand-staged oracle (jac-py/Modules/getbuildinfo.jac) is canonical for differential tests until idiom pack catches up; do not assert_lift_matches_c on fresh lift. After T8 tier-B burn-down on staged file, run sync_staged_to_lifted.py before re-measuring density.

Dual pipeline: Modules/_bisectmodule.jac is the C-API hand oracle (PyObj stubs) for cc differential tests; jacpython/_bisectmodule.jac is the native product facade (_p2_* list algorithms, no host py-block delegation). Not byte-identical. Staged file defines a no-op __jac_value__ so jac-run oracles survive native-lower fallback (decorator is a c2jac arch marker, not a runtime name). After T8 tier-B burn-down on staged oracle, run sync_staged_to_lifted.py before re-measuring density.
